about: Suggest a new feature or improvement

labels: enhancement
---

## Summary
What do you want BuFin to do that it doesn't today?

## Why this matters
What problem does this solve, or what's the actual use case? ("It would be nice" isn't enough on its own — help future-you or a reviewer understand the motivation.)

## Scope
If you have a sense of what this touches (frontend page/component, backend endpoint, new model/migration), sketch it out here. It's fine to leave this rough — a maintainer can help refine it before anyone starts building.

## Alternatives considered
Is there already a workaround, or a different way to solve the same problem? Mention it here even if you think this feature request is still the right call.

## Additional context
Anything else — mockups, links to similar features elsewhere, related issues.
